GENTEXT/PURPOSE/THIS MESSAGE PROVIDES POLICY AND GUIDANCE AND
OUTLINES REPORTING AND MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES FOR MAINTAINING
THE COP. IT IDENTIFIES KEY PERSONNEL, RELATIONSHIPS, RESPONSIBILITIES,
OPERATIONAL TASKS, AND TRUSTED NETWORKS TO EXCHANGE INFORMATION
EFFECTIVELY TO ACHIEVE MISSION SUCCESS THROUGH THE USE OF A COP//
GENTEXT/GUIDANCE AND POLICY/
THE COP CONSISTS OF THE COMMON TRACK/UNIT DATABASE, COMBINED WITH SHARED
GRAPHICS AND ASSOCIATED AMPLIFYING DATA FOR THE AOR. THIS INCLUDES
GRAPHICAL OVERLAYS (E.G. METEOROLOGICAL AND OCEANOGRAPHIC CENTER (METOC),
IMAGERY, ATO, ETC.) AND NEAR-REAL TIME POSITIONS OF FRIENDLY, NEUTRAL,
AND HOSTILE GROUND, MARITIME AND AIR TRACKS/UNITS. THE COP IS COMPILED
FROM COMMON TACTICAL PICTURES (CTPS) DEVELOPED BY THE THEATER REGIONAL
COMMANDS BASED ON SPECIFIC MISSIONS AND AORS. SITES THAT PROVIDE CTPS
TO THE COP ARE CALLED COP CORRELATION SITES (CCS). THE CCSS ARE:
COMPONENT, SUB-UNIFIED, JTF, AND AUTHORIZED SUPPORTING COCOMS, SERVICES
AND AGENCIES (C/S/A’S)//
